## Background 

Here we complete Lab 9, section 5, all about compartive analysis of protien strcutres.


## Setup

Load the packages we need for our analysis:
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(bio3d)
library(msa)

```


## Analysis  Pipeline 

The main input will be a single database ID(acession number). We can change this in the future to run our analysis on any protien family.
```{r}
id <- "1ake_A"
```

```{r}
aa <- get.seq(id)
aa
```

```{r}
# blast or hmmer search
#b <- blast.pdb(aa)
```



```{r}
hits <- NULL
hits$pdb.id <- c('1AKE_A','6S36_A','6RZE_A','3HPR_A','1E4V_A','5EJE_A','1E4Y_A','3X2S_A','6HAP_A','6HAM_A','4K46_A','3GMT_A','4PZL_A')

```


```{r}
# Download releated PDB files
files <- get.pdb(hits$pdb.id, path="pdbs", split=TRUE, gzip=TRUE)
```



```{r}
# Align releated PDBs
pdbs <- pdbaln(files, fit = TRUE, exefile="msa")
```


```{r}
library(bio3dview)

view.pdbs(pdbs)
```


```{r}
# Perform PCA
pc.xray <- pca(pdbs)
plot(pc.xray)
```

```{r}
plot(pc.xray, pc.axes = c(1,2))
```

```{r}
view.pca(pc.xray)
```


```{r}
# Visualize first principal component
pc1 <- mktrj(pc.xray, pc=1, file="pc_1.pdb")
```

We can view this trajectory in Mol-star...
